body: New EMILY/var/promptoverse-content-blocked.jsonl (append-only, never retried) records permanently-blocked (subject, style) attempts with structured reason/message. contentBlockedError refactored to a typed error carrying these fields. Live-verified end to end against the real Vertex AI API (temporary smoke test, removed after confirming). writeHardcodedStylesSnapshot exports the compiled-in registry to EMILY/var so IDUNA's discovery page can see it. Commits 2276638, 528dd7a.
title: Content-policy dead-letter dataset + hardcoded-styles export
